newsitem.title: USA: SMITH'S STARTS TENDER FOR $575 MLN OF NOTES.
newsitem.headline: SMITH'S STARTS TENDER FOR $575 MLN OF NOTES.

text.p: Smith's Food & Drug Centers Inc said Friday it started a cash tender offer for its outstanding 11-1/4 percent senior subordinated notes due 2007 with a principal amount of $575 million.
Smith said the tender offer, which expires September 8 1700 EDT/2100 GMT, is part of the refinancing to related to its pending merger with supermarket chain Fred Meyer Inc.

Smith's said it will pay for each $1,000 in principal amount the greater of $1,165 or an amount based on a 50-basis point spread over the yield of the 6 1/2 percent U.S. Treasury Note due May 31, 2001.

The regional supermarket and drug store chain said noteholders must pay a $20.00 per $1,000 in principal amount of notes, unless they consent on August 22 to effect certain amendments to the indenture under which the notes were issued.
Smith's said it expected to close the merger with Fred Meyer, on which the note tender is contingent, on September 8.
